name: dashboard-tooltip
title: DashboardTooltip
description: Token-colored tooltip preserving named series and value formatting.
docs: Requires React 19 and an initialized Tailwind v4 + shadcn project. Installs the tenboards default theme globally (light/dark, typography, density, focus and motion); review CSS changes. Components and exact UI dependencies live under components/tenboards, helpers under lib/tenboards. No server/data/auth dependencies.
